{{Quote|In the median, oddly, one of the tchuspera bushes was untouched &ndash; someone had put a torpedo through the head of a scout walker and what was left had settled onto its legs, standing over that one bush like it was protecting it.|Kinalos, ''The Year of Rage: A Citizen's History of the Coruscant Wars''|<ref name="Warfare12" />}}
The '''tchuspera''' was a [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Bush/Legends|bush]] that could be found on<ref name="Warfare12" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Tchuspera bushes grew in a median outside a [[Unidentified residential building (Coruscant)|building]] that contained the residence of a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Kinalos|soldier]] with the surname "Kinalos."<ref name="Warfare12" />

In Kinalos's [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[The Year of Rage: A Citizen's History of the Coruscant Wars]]'', when writing about the [[Second Battle of Coruscant]],<ref name="Warfare12" /> a battle of the [[Imperial Civil War]] fought in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> Kinalos described how an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|scout walker]] had been [[Missile/Legends|torpedoed]], causing it to fall into a position where it appeared to be guarding an undamaged, though dusty, tchuspera bush. Kinalos's [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], [[Samels]], knocked some of the dust off of the bush, and Kinalos described its bright green color as being a strange sight in the midst of so much ash.<ref name="Warfare12" />

==Behind the scenes==
The tchuspera was intended to appear in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'',<ref name="Warfare12" /> a [[2012]] reference book written by [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> However, the section of the book that described the tchuspera was ultimately cut before its release.<ref name="Warfare12" />

In [[2014]], the tchuspera was described in Part 12 of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Warfare12" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] that contained material cut from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'' as well as commentary on the cut sections.<ref name="Warfare12" />
